✦ COMBAT PUNCHY — 1.3.3 ✦

Cleaner sheathing. A smoother opening swing.

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge | Minecraft 1.20.1 · Forge

Offhand visibility

  • Fixed sheathed offhand items rendering in Epic Fight’s hand layer as well as on the back.
  • Unified the back display, vanilla hand suppression and Punchy’s arm/item visibility.
  • Restore the offhand for combat and active use, while respecting Moves’ item-swap transitions.

Combat handoff

  • Give an eligible opening attack immediate client-side visual ownership and refresh the combat timer on its input.
  • Keep the original attack intact, with Epic Fight’s normal stamina, animation, server and special-key rules.
  • Preserve the configurable seven-second inactivity timeout.

Compatibility and cleanup

  • Updated the tested Punchy version to 3.2b; Moves remains 1.0.9.
  • Replaced reflective API calls with typed integrations and explicit compatible minimum versions.
  • Reduced repeated patch/classification lookups and render allocations; clear cached player state when changing worlds or disconnecting.
  • Updated deprecated loader APIs used by the configuration and Forge item registry.

Replace your previous Combat Punchy JAR and keep your configuration. Optional animation integrations require Punchy 3.2a–3.2b and Moves 1.0.9. Each loader retains its matching Epic Fight version.
